questions.question:
Choose the correct sentence.

A) She has lived in London for five years ago.
B) She has lived in London since five years ago.
C) She has lived in London for five years now.
D) She has lived in London for a time of five years.
options: A) She has lived in London for five years ago.
B) She has lived in London since five years ago.
C) She has lived in London for five years now.
D) She has lived in London for a time of five years.
questions.answer: C) She has lived in London for five years now.

questions.question:
Which sentence is grammatically correct?

A) I have finished my homework yesterday.
B) I finished my homework yesterday.
C) I have finished my homework yesterday.
D) I have finished my homework yesterday.
options: A) I have finished my homework yesterday.
B) I finished my homework yesterday.
C) I have finished my homework yesterday.
D) I have finished my homework yesterday.
questions.answer: B) I finished my homework yesterday.

questions.question:
Complete the sentence with the correct form of the verb.

If I _____ more time, I would travel around the world.

A) have
B) had
C) will have
D) would have

Choose the correct option to complete the sentence.

By the time she _____ her studies, she _____ three languages.

A) finishes, has learned
B) will finish, will have learned
C) finishes, will have learned
D) will finish, has learned
options: B) will finish, will have learned

questions.question:
Which sentence correctly uses the present perfect tense?

A) I have seen that film last week.
B) I have seen that film since last week.
C) I have seen that film for last week.
D) I have seen that film until last week.
options: A) I have seen that film last week.
B) I have seen that film since last week.
C) I have seen that film for last week.
D) I have seen that film until last week.
questions.answer: B) I have seen that film since last week.

questions.question:
Select the correct comparative form.

Which country is _____ expensive than Japan?

A) more
B) much
C) many
D) most

Choose the correct sentence.

A) I am able to swim with my friends.
B) I am allowed to swim with my friends.
C) I am able to swim with my friends.
D) I am allowed to swim with my friends.
options: A) I am able to swim with my friends.
B) I am allowed to swim with my friends.
C) I am able to swim with my friends.
D) I am allowed to swim with my friends.
questions.answer: B) I am allowed to swim with my friends.

I would like _____ to Paris for my holiday.

B) going
C) to go
D) gone

If it _____ tomorrow, we won't go to the beach.

A) rains
B) will rain

D) were to rain

Choose the best word to complete the sentence.

After the long journey, he felt _____ tired.

A) very
B) much
C) so
D) too
